.liquid-glass { background: var(--glass-warm); background-blend-mode: luminosity; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: initial; position: relative; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 0px 1px 1px inset, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2) 0px 18px 60px; }

.liquid-glass::before { content: ""; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(rgba(244, 231, 211, 0.58) 0%, rgba(244, 231, 211, 0.22) 24%, rgba(244, 231, 211, 0.04) 48%, rgba(244, 231, 211, 0.06) 68%, rgba(244, 231, 211, 0.28) 100%); padding: 1px; position: absolute; inset: 0px; mask: linear-gradient(rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px) 0px 0px content-box exclude, linear-gradient(rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px) 0px 0px; }
